decision_rule: AC-S5-06 is met only if every target passes. Otherwise the failure is published and the CI remains labelled nominal/uncalibrated.
development_log: dev run 1 (50 replicates/scenario, development seeds only) showed: (a) default STA/LTA rejects 96-100 % of windows in the alpha = 1.5 coloured-noise scenarios, so no CI is produced (kept unchanged; reported as a QC limitation); (b) the transient scenario with 40 bursts per 30 min left about 10 clean windows, contrary to the spec's 'clean windows mixed with strong transients'; reduced to 12 bursts; (c) coverage 43/49 in flat_white, consistent with plain-percentile narrowness for k = 18 blocks; the expanded percentile interval (D-052) was adopted; (d) regime_switching under-covered (24/33, 27/37); the method was NOT changed for this.

added colored_mild_sdof (alpha = 0.75) and episodes_lognormal (white noise with amplitude episodes) so CI behaviour under coloured noise and under episodes can be evaluated at all; the harsh variants are kept.

dev run 2 (after the changes above): regime_switching still under-covers (26/33, 29/37) and the alpha = 1.5 scenarios still produce no CI; both are expected to fail on the test set and no further change was made.
no locked-test-set seed was used before the lock.

estimands.physical: ln|T(f)| of the generating transfer function at the coverage frequency (RMS-combined with any declared horizontal gain mismatch) and the true fundamental frequency; not a CI target
estimands.policy_mean: expected ln H/V at the coverage frequency over windows retained by the method's policy; estimated by pooling retained windows of all truth records
estimands.sdof_policy: SDOF R2_log greedy selection inside the plausible family matching the true fundamental (selected-regime mean)
estimands.standard_policy: basic QC + earliest-first non-overlapping windows (Standard reference)

matching_rules.false_peak: plausible family without possible_source_peak flag that matches no true transfer-function peak
matching_rules.family_matches_true_peak: true peak inside [lo_hz, hi_hz] or |log10(mean_peak_hz / true)| <= 0.1

metrics: bias of ln(fp/f0); median |ln(fp/f0)|; mean |fp - f0| / f0 (Standard and SDOF separately)
fundamental-correct rate; false-peak rate; source-flag rate
pointwise CI coverage of the policy mean (target) and of the physical amplitude (reported)
CI width in ln at the coverage frequency
no-result rates: ci_not_estimable, ci_limited, no SDOF selection, no fp
peak-replicate conditional interval coverage of f0 (reported, conditional, not a 95 % claim)
R2-vs-fundamental: R2-preferred family wrong; SDOF R2 above Standard windows while |fp error| worse

targets.rule: one-sided exact binomial test of H0: coverage >= 0.95 on replicates whose CI is estimated or limited; FAIL if p < 0.05/28; NOT EVALUABLE (counts as not met) with < 30 such replicates. Over-coverage passes and is reported.
